cs.t: I've been using a Sony mirrorless (anything above a5100 will work) for over 6 years now; it needed a "dummy battery", and an HDMI capture card (about $25 for noname brands, or $80+ for Elgato, BlackMagic etc). It auto-focuses, doesn't write to microsd, and works flawlessly. Even if you aren't buying Elgato, you can use Elgato's compatibility page to know which cameras work well:  https://www.elgato.com/us/en/s/cam-link-camera-check
cs.th: Canon wants us to pay for using our own camera as a webcam
